title: Scope replay signal lookup to selected source run
description:
Integration review of QuantAgent-3o8 found that `Backtest.run_replay()` loads signals only by symbol/timeframe/date/environment and does not reliably scope them to the selected source BacktestRun.

Evidence:
- Feature branch: `feature/QuantAgent-3o8-implement-replay-execution-mode-reuse-an`
- Replay proof run on 2026-05-10 showed source run 1 consuming signal ID 2 from a different overlapping run because `signal_map[(symbol, generated_at)]` was overwritten.
- Acceptance criteria TC5/TC11 require the replay to use the same source-run signals and keep the provenance chain traceable.

Required change:
1. Add or derive a robust signal-to-source-run linkage (explicit `backtest_run_id` on `Signal` or another deterministic provenance key already persisted).
2. Update replay signal loading to query only the selected source run.
3. Add tests covering overlapping runs with identical symbol/timeframe/timestamp to prevent cross-run signal contamination.
4. Revalidate replay provenance and no-LLM behavior before re-routing integration.

Out of scope:
- New replay UI features
- Parallel replay execution
- Broader backtest refactors

dependencies.title: Implement Replay execution mode (reuse analyses without LLM calls)
dependencies.description:
## Context
Requirement D in trading_system_requirements.md specifies that backtests should support 'replay execution' - reusing stored analyses with different Portfolio/Risk profiles without re-calling LLMs.

## Current State
- BacktestRun stores config_snapshot and analyses with checkpoints
- Signal model has thread_id, checkpoint_id, state_snapshot fields
- No replay execution mode implemented
- UI Replay tab exists but execution is not functional

## Acceptance Criteria
- Can select a completed backtest_run with stored analyses
- Can select one or multiple different portfolio/risk profiles
- Replay executes using stored analyses (no new LLM calls)
- Two executions over same analysis set but different profiles yield distinct P&L/metrics
- Comparison view shows side-by-side metrics and equity curves

## Technical Notes
- Implement in Backtest class or separate ReplayExecutor
- Sequential execution for multiple profiles (MVP decision)
- Reference: docs/03_design/strategy_assembler_architecture.md

### Skill: autodev-planner
- **Resultado:** SUCCESS
- **Run-ID:** 20260511T073839Z-QuantAgent-375-planner
- **Executor:** auto

#### Qué hice
- Analicé el bug de contaminación de señales en `run_replay()` confirmado en la revisión de QuantAgent-3o8 (2026-05-10)
- Identifiqué la causa raíz: `Signal` no tiene FK a `BacktestRun`, por lo que el `signal_map` se construye con filtros date+asset que no son únicos entre runs superpuestos
- Produje 4 documentos de planificación: RQ, PL, DS, AC
- Actualicé README.md en las 4 carpetas de docs

#### Evidencia
- `docs/01_requirements/QuantAgent-375-RQ-scope-replay-signal-lookup.md`
- `docs/02_planning/QuantAgent-375-PL-scope-replay-signal-lookup.md`
- `docs/03_design/QuantAgent-375-DS-scope-replay-signal-lookup.md`
- `docs/05_acceptance_tests/QuantAgent-375-AC-scope-replay-signal-lookup.md` (7 TCs)

#### Quality gates
- git status --short: PASS
- issue ID en paths: PASS
- acceptance criteria testables: PASS
- compileall: PASS

#### Problemas encontrados
- Ninguno. El diseño es minimal: una columna nullable `backtest_run_id` en `Signal`, una migración, dos touch points en creación de señales, y una query simplificada en `run_replay()`.
- Riesgo conocido: branch QuantAgent-3o8 está 207 commits detrás de main; necesita rebase después de que 375 mergee.

#### Next step recomendado
- Fase implementer en branch fresco desde `main` (`feature/QuantAgent-375-scope-replay-signal-lookup`)
- Steps 1–4 del PL en orden; Step 4 (update `run_replay()`) aplica cuando 3o8 se rebase
